LanguageData.HT_Enable: Enable real tribute for this charter
LanguageData.HT_OptIn: Optional experimental physical payments: enabling starts a new schedule now, with no retroactive bills. Manual delivery removes real caravan goods. Protection missions, faction membership changes and collection visits are not implemented.
LanguageData.HT_Account: Real tribute enabled. Only manual subject delivery is supported; no goods are taken automatically. Existing debts remain payable after mutual release.
LanguageData.HT_Bill: Period {0}: principal value {1}, delivery value {2}, due in {3} days (negative means past due).
LanguageData.HT_Overdue: Overdue. This does not automatically assign dishonor or start a war.
LanguageData.HT_Choose: Select a caravan at the counterparty settlement
LanguageData.HT_NoCaravan: Bring a player caravan onto a settlement tile owned by the charter's liege faction, then select payment again.
LanguageData.HT_RealWarning: REAL DELIVERY — confirming transfers the selected inventory into the NPC settlement's trade stock. Prices use the game's current sell-price rules. Excess value is not refunded or applied to other bills. Only ordinary inventory items are supported. This code has not been tested in gameplay.
LanguageData.HT_Deliver: Confirm delivery of these real goods
LanguageData.HT_Delivered: Physical tribute delivered and receipt recorded.
LanguageData.HT_Recover: Recover pending delivery or return verified goods
LanguageData.HT_Recovery: Recovery attempted. Unproven transfers remain reserved; retained escrow is not discarded. The bill is not reopened until the full return is verified.
LanguageData.HT_Unavailable: Payment unavailable or quote changed. Check ledger status, current ownership, caravan location, negotiator, goods and quoted value. Favor-based or title-restricted trading is not supported yet. An interrupted transfer remains reserved for recovery.
LanguageData.HCL_Warning: DEVELOPMENT CHARTER RECORDS — real settlement references with separate NPC/player consent. Physical tribute requires explicit opt-in and manual delivery below. Protection, faction membership and shared diplomacy are not enforced yet. Native player control is preserved. The fictional model is separate. Gameplay validation is deferred.
LanguageData.HCL_Unavailable: Charter action unavailable: check the current owner, representative, diplomacy, pending offers and existing bonds.
LanguageData.HCL_NpcAgreed: The NPC representative accepted the proposed record. Review the terms and confirm your own consent separately.
LanguageData.HCL_NpcDeclined: The NPC representative declined. This initial negotiation policy requires at least {0} goodwill for this role.
LanguageData.HCL_ReleaseRefused: The NPC representative declined release; the charter remains active. This initial policy requires 20 goodwill.
LanguageData.HCL_Terms: Recorded terms: fixed tribute value 100 every 5 days, 1-day grace; subject delivery with a 10% transport allowance. Optional manual physical tribute starts only after enabling it. Protection requires timely troop support, but its enforcement is pending. NPC acceptance currently requires 0 goodwill to become your liege, or 50 to become your vassal; honor/performance negotiation is pending.
LanguageData.HCL_SeekLiege: Request this settlement's faction as liege of all player colonies
LanguageData.HCL_OfferProtection: Offer protection as liege of this settlement
LanguageData.HCL_Empty: No charter records. Select an NPC world settlement to request terms.
LanguageData.HCP_Warning: DEVELOPMENT MODEL — fictional domains and simulated receipts. No real items, native factions or combat are changed. Gameplay validation is deferred. Capture outcomes do not yet transfer territory. This window pauses the game.
LanguageData.HCP_Rejected: Model action unavailable: check the bond, deadline, available troops and existing obligations.
LanguageData.HCP_RestoreFailed: Model restore failed. The original snapshot is preserved; this preview is disabled. See the log.
LanguageData.HCP_Interval: World turn interval: {0} days (fixed for this preview save).
